crossRefs.note: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink, who stay late into the night, until…
The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh…
Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
Go your way—eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a merry heart; for God has already accepted your works.
who strum on the strings of a harp; who invent for themselves instruments of music, like David;
The songs of the temple will be wailing in that day,” says the Lord Yahweh. “The dead bodies will be many. In every…
I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will make you wear sackcloth on all…
Yahweh of Armies will defend them; and they will destroy and overcome with sling stones; and they will drink, and roar…
Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

translations.web: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
translations.bsb: They no longer sing and drink wine; strong drink is bitter to those who consume it.
translations.kjv: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink
translations.asv: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
